property_summary: For any admissible input, after lockInGuess at block N, settle() must revert when called at block N+1 because the stored target block is N+1 (block.number > target fails); the mutant stores N, so settle at N+1 succeeds, violating the rule.
change_summary: Replace the stored target block with block.number so settle's blockhash is taken for the lock-in block itself.
